vo-1-2: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen! I'm Technickel, conductor of A I. Behind every great musician is a very inconvenient instrument.

vo-a: Most music in V R is a rhythm game, or a mixed reality overlay on a guitar you already own. Chordless is the instrument. Real strings, real frets. Just your hands.
vo-b: It's built with Meta's Immersive Web S D K, so it runs right in the Quest browser. No install, no controllers. Ten instruments, and more than sixty places to play them.
vo-7-2: That's Chordless. Not a game about music: an orchestra you can play, and break, in a headset.
